newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end up on solid 11-mo company results.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end up on solid 11-mo company results.

text.p: Shares on the Lima Stock Exchange closed up in low volume as the few players who returned from vacation reacted positively to earnings reports for the first 11 months of 1996 published Thursday, brokers said.
They added the market would likely rise again Friday, but volume would remain weak due to the continued absence of investors on holiday over the New Year period.
Thursday, the General Index rose 0.34 percent to 1,427.9 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index edged up 0.08 percent to 2,014.8 points.
"There was a strong push up due to good performances of blue chips," said Alberto Giha of brokerage 4G, referring to today's spate of earnings reports.
Benchmark Telefnica del Per led the market up, climbing 2.47 percent to 4.98 soles on volume of 919,000 shares.
In a total of 694 trades, volume was estimated at 13.9 million soles ($5.4 million).
